CommunityApplications.Profile: MediaForge is a self-hosted media ingest engine for Unraid. It watches an incoming folder, identifies movies and TV episodes via TMDB/TVDB/OMDb, verifies matches with an optional LLM, transcodes H.264 to HEVC (or AV1) with hardware acceleration and VMAF-driven quality control, and files finished media into your Plex/Jellyfin/Emby library using server-compatible naming. Anything that can't be processed automatically is routed to a Review Queue with a specific reason instead of failing silently. This repository maintains the MediaForge Docker template. Support: https://github.com/braydin72/MediaForge/issues
